observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a new host-allowlist check for the TypeSafe AI domain, while removing the hosted endpoint from the shared evaluation path.
observations.code_quote: # TypeSafe is not a subprocessor. Only a team's own System One connection may send data there.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk adds a guard in the provider key serializer: if the supplied base_url resolves to typesafe.ai, the serializer rejects it unless the request is routed through a System One connection. This prevents a generic provider key from reaching the hosted endpoint, supporting the documented claim that only a team's own System One connection may send data there.
